reflow_constraints.resolution: HOLD: obtain a factory-qualified profile within these limits, or review a high-temperature capacitor and its footprint before changing the BOM.

assembly_review.scope: Catalog service eligibility is not solder-process qualification. D10 MSL 4 handling and all exact-part thermal limits require the factory process review; a 260 C solder-heat reliability test is not a reflow recipe.

routing_review.scope: Authorized 14-segment input widening from 0.5 to 0.7 mm and regenerated fills. Exact native comparison preserves every other object. Four-layer CAD/Gerber and expanded DC checks refreshed; transient simulations deferred.

previous_review.scope: Authorized ground-pour cleanup. CAD/DC/Gerber checks refreshed; transient simulations deferred.

equivalence_review.scope: Six changed passive types at nine placements checked against original and replacement manufacturer specifications and actual native pad dimensions. The other 49 factory types retain exact manufacturer/MPN. No BOM or CAD change in this audit.

substitutions.differences: Body thickness and insulation-resistance limits differ. KEMET specifies 100 Gohm; Yageo minimum is 10 Gohm. At 8 MHz and 30 pF the capacitive reactance is about 663 ohm, so this leakage difference is negligible for the intended load. No claim of identical parasitics or verified oscillator startup.

substitutions.power_derating: Both rate full power at 70 C and derate to zero at 155 C; voltage is also limited by sqrt(P*R).
substitutions.overload_test: Both families specify 2.5 times rated working voltage or maximum overload voltage, whichever is lower, for 5 seconds. This is not a repetitive-surge qualification.
substitutions.differences: Body dimensions/tolerances vary within the reviewed 0805/1206 land pattern. This review does not claim identical long-term drift or surge behavior.
